definitions.explanation: The sound made by walking or stepping.

examples.japanese: {足音|あしおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
{足音|あしおと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てないで→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: Don't make noise with your footsteps.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{足音|あしおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}めた→覚める：02058_sameru⟧。
examples.english: I heard footsteps in the hallway in the middle of the night and woke up.

notes:
{足音|あしおと} is a compound of ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot) + ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ (sound).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {足音|あしおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧ (hear footsteps)
- {足音|あしおと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (make footstep sounds)
- {足音|あしおと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忍|しの}ばせる→忍ばせる：12680_shinobaseru⟧ (muffle one's footsteps)

NOTE: Often used in context of detecting someone approaching or describing quiet/loud walking.
